name: – Gheorghe Falcă – § 21 – Am 38
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text: 21. Takes note of the sudden increase in petitions of Spanish origin in the second half of 2023 concerning the risks to the rule of law in Spain as a result of the Spanish Government’s intention to adopt an Amnesty Law contrary to constitutional and European law; deplores the attacks on the rule of law and the separation of powers carried out by the Spanish Government;
